study type: Retrospective cohort study; prediction model development
outcome: Success rate of external cephalic version
cohort: The study included data from 317 women who underwent external cephalic version (ECV) over a 6-year period.
finding: External cephalic version is a successful and safe technique with a high rate of subsequent vaginal delivery, and a prediction model was developed based on easily obtained variables to personalize the probability of success.
mod_finding: Among women with successful ECV, 77% (163 of 212) achieved a vaginal birth.
